quests.title: Fishing For Jade

dialogue.t: A perfectly good Jade Chamber... Gone, just like that...
Ah, the Jade Chamber... To think that it could truly be rebuilt...
Hmm... I suppose you can just keep that Mora. It isn't much, so I suppose you can keep it as compensation for your help.
This box, on the other hand, is unknown to me. You might want to pass it on to Baiwen.
She's currently attending to some business at Yuehai Pavilion. Perhaps she might know what it is.
Hello, how may I help you?

dialogue.sit: I picked this up from the sea...

dialogue.t: Hmm? Allow me to have a look.
Yes, this does indeed come from the Jade Chamber.

dialogue.sit: Anything specific you could tell me?

dialogue.t: Well, the contents consist of several documents and an announcement that has yet to undergo review. To think that they are still so well-preserved... How unexpected.
Still, your find should save us some work. Cleaning up after this mess really has proved an unending font of busywork.
Still, thank you for bringing these to us. Do take this as a token of our appreciation.
Hello, how may I help you?

dialogue.sit: I picked this up from the ocean...

dialogue.t: Hmm? Allow me to have a look.
Yes, this does indeed come from the Jade Chamber.

dialogue.sit: Anything specific you could tell me?

dialogue.t: Well, the contents consist of several documents and an announcement that has yet to undergo review. To think that they are still so well-preserved... How unexpected.
They are somewhat out of date, but still, thank you for bringing these to us. Do take this as a token of our appreciation.

quests.description: In the aftermath of the collision between the Jade Chamber and That Which Lies in the Deep, the sea remains dotted with floating fragments of the Jade Chamber. The Millelith soldier Kun is currently looking for help with the cleanup work…
